parameters.name: AcceleratorId
parameters.description: The ID of the Global Accelerator instance.

parameters.name: AccessLogSwitch
parameters.description:
Whether to enable the access log. Valid values:

- **on**: enables the access log.

- **off** (default): disables the access log.

parameters.name: EndpointGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the endpoint group.

parameters.name: EndpointGroupType
parameters.description:
The type of the endpoint group. Valid values:

- **default**: a default endpoint group.

- **virtual**: a virtual endpoint group.

- If you omit this parameter, the operation returns all default and virtual endpoint groups.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: **50**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the Global Accelerator instance is deployed. Set the value to **cn-hangzhou**.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags used to filter endpoint groups. You can specify up to 20 tags.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 64 characters long and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, or contain `http://` or `https://`.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
The tag value. The tag value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters long and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, or contain `http://` or `https://`.
